activity.notes: Taharqa was a Twenty-fifth Dynasty Kushite pharaoh of Egypt. ATLAS records Egypt separately from his Kingdom of Kush sovereignty so both historically meaningful political associations are preserved without replacing either with a generic Nubia label.

sources.title: Taharqo — British Museum
sources.citation_text: The British Museum identifies Taharqo/Taharqa as a Twenty-fifth Dynasty Nubian ruler of Egypt and King of Upper and Lower Egypt, dated 690–664 BCE.
